## Experience

- **.NET Senior Associate, LogicTree IT Solutions (2023 – present)** — Leads full-stack delivery of FormTrackR, a cloud-native form builder and submission tracker. Owns requirements, technical design, ASP.NET Core REST APIs, React UI, Azure Blob Storage uploads, Azure Functions, Azure AI Foundry features, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews and production support.
- **.NET Junior Associate, LogicTree IT Solutions (Aug 2019 – 2023)** — Full-stack developer on USPD Hub (SmartConnect Apps), a white-label web and mobile app platform. Built the ASP.NET Web API behind the mobile apps, helped migrate from ASP.NET Web Forms to ASP.NET Core MVC with EF Core, built a JavaScript form builder, wrote SQL Server stored procedures, and deployed to Azure App Service with scheduled Azure WebJobs.
